name: org.shirousa.jsonbehavior
displayName: JSON Behavior Import for Unity Behavior
description: Author Unity Behavior graphs as plain JSON and transcribe them into native, fully-compiled .asset files — no visual editor required. Built for AI-assisted workflows: JSON is easy for an LLM or coding agent to generate, review as a diff, and validate, unlike a node graph's positional layout. Existing Action/Condition nodes (yours and Unity's 45 built-ins) run completely unmodified, with full native debugger support.

samples.description: A minimal pet AI declaration that follows the player and switches behavior on aggro.
